_comment: Maximum number of mypy type errors allowed per target. CI fails when a
target reports more errors than its limit, so new code cannot add type
errors while the existing backlog is worked down.
When you fix errors, lower the number here in the same change -- the
check prints the exact replacement value when it sees a decrease.

CI venv (Pillow, opentelemetry, inspect-ai) surfaced 8 pre-existing
errors in files no diff had touched (image_resize, eval/*). They belong
to the tracked backlog, not to the change that hit the red gate.
